scientific_integrity: Universal theorem proved by a zero-sum dipole reduction, exact infinitesimal inequalities and Euler semigroup limit. Finite combinatorial and numerical checks are supporting diagnostics, not an infinite proof. The submission is not independently validated.
scientific_limitations: Only finite simple cycles with unit-conductance combinatorial heat, independently positive edge-variation weights, real signals. Not weighted-conductance or nonlinear heat. Priority is a best-knowledge comparison and may be revised by independent research.
title: Anisotropic variation stability of cycle heat flow: the seven-edge rigidity threshold
